background.md 中 EXP-001 首次出现无 story 或文件出处引用，fresh reader 需要外部知识才能定位原始实验文档（B-e71f 下的 exp-001.md）

CHK-001 and CHK-002 both lack userSees fields -- no concrete user-facing transcript describing what the user observes when the fallback is used or when the reload hint appears. Risk: story closes engineering-green but product-reviewer cannot verify user-value closure without a target transcript.

Background and description are written entirely in engineering/mechanism language (gate, signing, subagent spawning). The user pain point (story permanently stuck) is buried. Recommend adding one sentence of plain outcome: what does the user see differently after this story ships?
